data.description: Currently staff are global, we need to make assign  them directly to a business. For example, a Barrista can only be employed and placed on a Cafe. When a staff member is placed on a business their effects are added to those of the shop and their card is stacked below the shop card. placing the mouse on the overlapping section of the card will provide the information pop up. This means that each space in the street should be displayed using the core engine hand tooling. When working on this issue update all staff cards in the CSV so they can be placed on one or more businesses. Create specialist staff that increase the income of the store they are placed on, e.g. Barrista for cafe, Florist for Florist
data.title: Staff for businesses
